description: A Flutter widget defining an OTP validation screen, including social sign-in options, phone number input, and testing bypass functionality.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget facilitating OTP validation, social sign-in, and testing bypass for a Flutter mobile app.

methods.name: _buildSocialButton
methods.description: Creates a styled social sign-in button with customizable icon, label, colors, and tap handler.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the continue button, including triple-tap testing bypass.

methods.name: _bypassLoginForTesting
methods.description: Sets login preferences to bypass actual authentication for testing purposes and navigates to home screen.

methods.name: _onContinueWithPhone
methods.description: Proceeds to OTP second screen if a valid 10-digit phone number is entered.

methods.name: _onGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Mocks Google sign-in process by setting preferences and navigating to the home screen.
